quote: A big thank you to the staff at Todu Guam for their amazing assistance during a critical time for care. As a person who experiences the gaps of medical care within our island, it is reassuring to have experienced the warm hearted and diligent work their staff focuses on for the community as a whole. A big highlight was assistance provided by Ms. Ashley Calvo-Rodriguez, Stephanie L. Taijeron APRN, AGNP-C to name a few… they truly went above and beyond to not only transition us to being admitted at GMH but to continuously follow up on progress while we’ve been here. From the bottom of our hearts, thank you, to the whole Todu Guam team.
author: Devin Frazier

quote: Todu Guam does great outreach in the community. They are an amazing organization with a HUGE Heart! I could not more highly recommend!
